name: Financial Incentive For Inter-Caste Marriages Under Protection Of Civil Rights Act 1955 And Scheduled Castes And Scheduled Tribes (Prevention Of Atrocities) Act 1989 In Assam
benefit:
- A one-time financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- is provided to the eligible inter-caste marriage couple.
- The financial assistance is granted directly in the form of a fixed deposit.
- The fixed deposit is opened jointly in the name of the couple in a Government or Nationalized bank.

***Conditions***
_*The opening of joint accounts for the eligible inter-caste marriage couple will be initiated
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a spouse in an inter-caste marriage. - The applicant must ensure that one spouse of the inter-caste marriage belongs to the Scheduled Caste. - The applicant must ensure that the other spouse of the inter-caste marriage belongs to the General Caste Hindu. - The applicant must have had their marriage officially performed between 1st January 2025 and 31st January 2025. - The applicant must be applying for their first marriage, as there will be no incentive provided for a second or subsequent marriage. - The applicant must have a combined annual income of the couple from all sources of income of ₹5,00,000/- and below.
